core_obligations: Observe D_QCoh,T(O_X) is a triangulated category with direct sums (remark preceding the lemma); by Proposition compact-is-perfect the perfect objects of D(O_X) are compact, hence a fortiori compact in any direct-sum-closed subcategory, proving the easy direction (proof lines 4537-4544).
Conversely, take the generator E of D_QCoh,T(O_X) which is a perfect complex of O_X-modules, furnished by Lemma generator-with-support; by the above E is compact (proof lines 4545-4549).

By Derived Categories, Proposition generator-versus-classical-generator, the compact object E is a classical generator of the full subcategory of compact objects of D_QCoh,T(O_X); hence every compact object is obtained from E by shifts, finite direct sums, cones and direct summands, and each of these operations preserves being perfect, so every compact object is perfect (proof lines 4550-4557).
proof_roadmap: Easy direction: perfect objects are compact, compactness passing to direct-sum-closed subcategories (proof lines 4537-4544).
Take the perfect generator with support (proof lines 4545-4549).
Conclude via the classical generator theorem and thick-subcategory bookkeeping (proof lines 4550-4557).
